R2F Trading breaks down exactly how institutions move price before inflation data — so you stop being the liquidity. Follow r2ftrading.com for daily ICT setups.
script: Stop trading CPI week like this. 73% of funded accounts fail during high-impact news. Not because of the news — because of what happens RIGHT before it. Mistake one.
